cands.name: Webster Barnaby
cands.bio: Republican incumbent, 66. Born in Birmingham, England, to Jamaican parents; naturalized in 1998. Deltona resident, pastor and business owner; Deltona City Council 2012-2020; House since 2020.

record.text: Deltona City Council 2012-2020; elected to the House in 2020; HD 29 since 2022.
Co-introduced the 2023 voucher bill (HB 1), voted for the six-week abortion ban (SB 300) and for HB 991 (proof of citizenship), per the ClickOrlando guide.
Won the 2022 Republican primary over fellow Rep. Elizabeth Fetterhoff after a recount.

controversies.text: In April 2023, during a debate on a bathroom bill, he compared transgender people to X-Men "mutants" and called them "demons and imps"; he later apologized.

endorsements.text: Florida Fraternal Order of Police backed him in 2022.

cands.gaps: Current donors not found. votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
Building Safety (condo safety response after Surfside).
